clips.name: Idle
clips.description: Relaxed breathing and small head and shoulder movements.

clips.name: Wave
clips.description: Raises his right hand, waves hello, then lowers it; the body stays still.

clips.name: Walk
clips.description: Grounded alternating steps and opposite arm swings, ready for hand-target steering.

clips.name: Jog
clips.description: Quicker approach steps with bent elbows and higher foot lifts; stays in place.

clips.name: Headpat
clips.description: Ducks for a headpat and does three comically pleased head bobs.

clips.name: Petting
clips.description: A silly head-scratch reaction with relaxed arms, a tilted head, and a contented sway.

clips.name: Curious
clips.description: Looks toward a hand and tips his head as if listening.

clips.name: Nod
clips.description: Two gentle acknowledgement nods.

clips.name: High five
clips.description: Offers his right palm and holds it briefly; the body stays still.

clips.name: Beckon
clips.description: Curls his raised right forearm toward himself twice; the body stays still.

clips.name: Celebrate
clips.description: An energetic two-arm cheer and small knee bounce.

clips.name: Shrug
clips.description: A playful two-arm shrug with upturned hands.

clips.name: Startled
clips.description: Quickly recoils with raised hands and bent knees, then relaxes.

clips.name: Drowsy
clips.description: Slow breathing and a gently bowed, bobbing head.

rig.method: Anatomical skeleton; surface-connected arm ownership with a blended shoulder band and hard body anchors.
